exposure: Women with one previous cesarean section
outcome: Contribution of each Robson group to the overall CS rate
cohort: 4,356 women admitted for childbirth at a Honduran maternity hospital between August 2017 and October 2018
finding: The study found that Groups 5, 1, and 3 of the Robson Ten Group Classification were the main contributors to the cesarean section rate, while Groups 2 and 4 showed the impact and importance of induction of labor in reducing CS rates.
mod_finding: Groups 2a (term primiparous) and 4a (term multiparous) had high induction success with low CS rates (18.4% and 16.9%, respectively).
